summary: Garland County lookout whose 1956 NGS description gives a 47.5 ft steel-legged tower; a 1970 fire reported south of Ouachita Pinnacle is recalled, but no source says if the tower stands.

facts.design: Four steel legs carrying a lookout house about 15 feet square

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description, dated 1956 in its record, describes the lookout tower.
Ouachita Pinnacle Fire, reported south of Ouachita Pinnacle and started April 9, 1970, as recalled by the Jessieville District ranger. The account is about the fire and does not describe the lookout.

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing, current status or access source was found, so those keys are omitted. The Friends of the Ouachita page shows a tower photo (Ouachita-Pinnacle-Fire-Tower.jpg) with no credit or license, so it is not added to photos. The fire account does not mention the tower; the story keeps fire and tower separate. Do not confuse with Pinnacle Mountain State Park (Pulaski County) or the Pinnacle Mountain Fire Tower in Tennessee's Cherokee National Forest, both of which appeared in searches.
